events.summary: Judge Dabney Friedrich issued an order and opinion granting Defendants' motion to dismiss the complaint's only remaining count - the Fifth Amendment allegation - without prejudice. In granting the motion to dismiss, the court held that Primus failed to state a claim of race discrimination because he “essentially trie[d] to bring a disparate-impact claim,” which alone is insufficient to establish discriminatory intent.
